# `set_camera_bin`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set the camera bin factor.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcf680, SetBin @0x11f2b0 (64-bit build) |

Required integer, scalar or first array element. On the ordinary camera page the value must be in the camera's supported bin list (get_camera_info bins); on application page 1 (video capture) it must satisfy 1 <= value <= the maximum bin. There is no default. Result 0 means the bin was applied; no acquisition wait is involved. A closed camera fails with 318.

Side effects: Updates the selected camera's bin (under the camera lock) or, on application page 1, the video-capture bin.

Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_camera_bin"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | yes | - | Required bin factor. Absent, empty array, null or a non-integer fails with 104. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 104 | Params missing, empty array, null or not an integer | `expected int param` |
| 318 | Camera is closed (ordinary page) | `device not connected` |
| 210 | Bin not in the camera's supported list (ordinary page) | `not supported` |
| 204 | Video-page bin outside 1..maximum | `out of limit` |
| 207 | Operation failure whose thread-local error code is zero (the default substituted when the callee set none); other callee-set codes are forwarded unchanged | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

The source does not say whether the bin takes effect for an exposure already in progress.

## Example

Request, array:

```json
{"id":39,"method":"set_camera_bin","params":[2]}
```

Request, scalar:

```json
{"id":40,"method":"set_camera_bin","params":1}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_camera_bin","result":0,"code":0,"id":39}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_camera_bin","error":"not supported","code":210,"id":41}
```
